_meta.fuenteNiveles: Niveles core/working confirmados desde HojaVidaJonathanIngles.pdf. Niveles exposure confirmados por el usuario en la entrevista del 2026-08-24.

niveles.core: Skill principal. Va primero en SKILLS y puede aparecer en bullets de experiencia sin matiz.
niveles.working: Uso real y repetido. Va en SKILLS sin matiz.
niveles.exposure: Tocado, no dominado. Va agrupado al final como 'Familiar with: ...'. NUNCA se afirma como experiencia principal en un bullet.

_meta.reglaBullets: bulletsVariantes reformulan el MISMO hecho con otro vocabulario. Elegir la variante que mas terminos de la oferta cubra. Un bullet no listado aqui es un claim sin respaldo: se marca verificado:false y se aprueba con el usuario.

summaryVariantes.texto: Senior Mobile Developer with 6+ years building and shipping production Flutter applications for iOS and Android, including one with 500K+ downloads. Strong in Clean Architecture, state management (BLoC, Riverpod, Provider) and integrating REST APIs, cloud services and third-party SDKs. Experienced working remotely with distributed US and LatAm startup teams.

Senior Flutter Developer with 6+ years delivering high-traffic mobile products for iOS and Android, including a marketplace app with 500K+ downloads across Latin America. Focused on scalable, maintainable architecture, performance and analytics-driven iteration in fast-moving startup environments.

Senior Mobile Engineer with 6+ years specialized in Flutter/Dart, applying Clean Architecture, SOLID and layered design to keep large codebases testable and maintainable. Experienced mentoring developers, running code reviews and setting mobile engineering standards inside product teams.

Senior Flutter Developer with 6+ years partnering closely with product and design to ship user-facing mobile features end to end. Comfortable owning a feature from Figma handoff through release to the App Store and Google Play, and iterating on it with analytics and user feedback.

Senior Mobile Developer with 6+ years building Flutter applications that lean heavily on integrations: third-party SDKs, real-time video, geolocation, payments-adjacent flows, analytics platforms and cloud backends. Used to reading vendor documentation and making unfamiliar SDKs work in production.
